orthogonal-modality-stack-promcalc-plus-.name: orthogonal-modality-stack-promcalc-plus-N-channels
orthogonal-modality-stack-promcalc-plus-.evidence: wiki/glm_tile_stack_arm_2026-10-26.md + wiki/glm_tile_hybrid_arm_2026-10-26.json -- STACKING VERDICT WEAK_STACK against the bar pre-registered BEFORE the run (PREREGISTERED['stacking'], margin 0.02, 8/10 seeds, comparator hybrid_conv_maxtx). A THIRD CHANNEL DOES ADD: decomposition-as-third +0.4404 median, paired +0.0145 over the 2-channel hybrid on 10/10 seeds, CI95 [0.0108, 0.0172] EXCLUDING ZERO. The 4-channel is WORSE than the 3-channel (+0.0103, 9/10, CI95 [0.0039, 0.0156]), and gc-as-third LOSES (-0.0039, 4/10, CI95 [-0.0095, 0.0026] includes zero) -- so gc subtracts on top of the winning pair. WEAK_STACK not NO_STACK: it clears the seed count 10/10 outright and misses only the INHERITED 0.02 margin, which is NOT being revisited (lowering a bar a real signal just missed is the retro-fit the plan was written to avoid). MY PRE-REGISTERED PREDICTION WAS FALSIFIED -- I predicted NO_STACK for both new combos. THE ORTHOGONALITY ARGUMENT IS BACKWARDS, NOT MERELY INSUFFICIENT: decomposition is the MOST redundant channel with the comparator (+0.7812) and is the one that ADDS, while gc is markedly LESS redundant (+0.5508 / +0.4593) and SUBTRACTS -- pairwise Spearman between prediction vectors does not order these channels by whether they stack, so it is not a valid screen on this rung. SCOPED 2026-10-26, and the unscoped version above over-reached: max_tx and decomposition are NOT two modalities -- scripts/glm_tile_predictions.py hands the SAME decomposition dict to tile_features() and to max_tx_scalar(), the latter returning a single log1p(max Tx_rate), so max_tx is a lossy SCALAR REDUCTION of exactly what decomposition sees in full. Their +0.7812 redundancy is therefore mechanically expected, and the pair that is most redundant while still stacking is a REDUCTION/SUPERSET pair. What is refuted is prediction-vector Spearman as a screen ACROSS THAT PAIR; it is NOT shown invalid between genuinely different modality families, none of which were tested here -- so the ProteinGym modality-hybrid finding (wiki/forward_modality_hybrid_2026-07-17.md, where the channels ARE different families) stands untouched. Read this arm's result as 'finer-grained access to a channel already present pays', not as 'a new kind of information pays'. Full derivation: wiki/glm_tile_stack_arm_2026-10-26.md section SCOPE on that finding. REGRESSION CLEAN: every published 2-channel value is byte-identical to git HEAD's artifact (_paired_hybrid_vs_comparator +0.0339 CI95 [0.0238, 0.0409], verdict HYBRID_ADDS), so the generalisation added questions without perturbing the answered one. All 10 seeds, every combo at n=10, _short_arm and _skipped_combos both absent.
orthogonal-modality-stack-promcalc-plus-.rationale: The incumbent best is a 2-channel rank-average (promcalc-plus-conv-rank-average-hybrid-150bp, rho 0.4254) that wins 10/10 seeds with a paired CI excluding zero, and whose SHUFFLED-CONV control HURTS (-0.1232, 0/10) -- so the gain is channel CONTENT, not the averaging. Whether that STACKS to 3+ orthogonal channels is untested here, and it is the exact shape of the published ESM2+GEMME+ProSST result (+0.056, 90.5% of proteins) that the 2-channel version already echoed once.

pyramid-4scale-2.22decades-499bp-fragmen.name: pyramid-4scale-2.22decades-499bp-fragments
pyramid-4scale-2.22decades-499bp-fragmen.rationale: The reachable re-scope of multiresolution-pyramid-4-decades-UNRUN, which its own probe measured as substrate-gated at 60.1x. SPAN CORRECTED 2026-10-27 (measured, was overstated 2.5x): the arm's NAME carries the MAX span log10(499/3)=2.2210, but that is realised on 49 of 321,123 fragments. Median length is 244 bp = 1.9103 decades, p99 308 bp, and only 4.0% of rows reach 300 bp. So against the measured sibling pyramid-4scale-1.70decades-150bp the honest gain is +0.21 decades at the MEDIAN (244/150 = 1.63x more length), NOT +0.52 / 3.33x. Quote the median. Every branch is still a real biological scale (no degenerate 1 bp branch, which encoder.py rejects as inflating the metric without testing the hypothesis it stands for). Substrate is already local: 321,123 rows (LB) / 318,457 (M9) at 48-499 bp. COMPARATOR CARE -- this arm is on the FRAGMENT rung (ceiling 0.7928), NOT the tile rung (0.941), so its number must NEVER be read against the sibling's 0.3167 or against promcalc's 0.3968: the census ceiling_rule says each rung carries its own ceiling and none is inherited. The fragment-rung incumbent is kmer4 at spearman 0.1313 (30,000 rows). OPEN DESIGN POINT for the pre-registration: fragments are VARIABLE length (359 distinct), and load_fragments' own docstring states k-mer features are the length-invariant honest default here, so a fixed-window pyramid needs a pad/crop rule DECLARED BEFORE the run.
